beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: In this town, everybody dances.
beats.visual: Crane down the party street, everybody dancing.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Except me.
beats.visual: Push in on an upstairs window; inside, Brenda stands bolt upright, sunglasses on, frozen.

beats.speaker: brenda
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!
beats.visual: Brenda's room: her body doesn't move a millimetre; only her face snaps to 'huss' on each HUSS.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Grandad's DJ name? Grandad.
beats.visual: Grandad DJing on the street in sunglasses and headphones; tag DJ GRANDAD on the punchline.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: While they're out partying, by the way, I'm home. Not moving.
beats.visual: Static wide of the bedroom: Brenda frozen on the rug, party lights flicker in the window.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Day one: four seconds.
beats.visual: DAY 1 card + stopwatch 0:01-0:04; on 'seconds' she wobbles, face 'sweat'.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Day forty: the cat thinks I'm a bookshelf.
beats.visual: DAY 40: the cat loafs on top of her head, staring into the lens.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Be a fridge. Cold. Still. Full of snacks. My dentist.

card.quote: Be a fridge. Cold. Still. Full of snacks.

beats.visual: QUOTE CARD over a slow zoom on Brenda with the cat on her head; attribution on 'My dentist'.

beats.speaker: brenda
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!
beats.visual: Tight on Brenda + cat: face 'huss' per HUSS, body still, a sweat drop slides; the cat doesn't blink.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Top ten respectful moments. Number seven: Grandad dusted me.
beats.visual: TOP 10 card; Grandad dusts Brenda's shoulders and the cat with a feather duster, then nods.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Then came the Freeze Dance Championship.
beats.visual: Square, banner SUMMER PARTY / FREEZE DANCE / CHAMPIONSHIP, stage packed with dancers.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Marcus sneezed. He's out!
beats.visual: Music stops, everyone freezes. Marcus jolts on 'sneezed'; red OUT stamp.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: The mayor's mustache twitched. He's out!
beats.visual: ECU on the frozen mayor; one tiny twitch; red OUT stamp.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Never trust a man who blinks. A fish.

card.quote: Never trust a man who blinks.

beats.visual: QUOTE CARD over a slow dolly along the frozen contestants; attribution on 'A fish'.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Hours later. Just me and a lamppost.
beats.visual: 3 AM card; the stage is empty except Brenda and a lamppost with its own bib. The crowd is half asleep.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Be the lamp, not the moth. A moth.

card.quote: Be the lamp, not the moth.

beats.visual: QUOTE CARD; behind it a tiny moth circles the lamppost bulb; attribution on 'A moth'.

beats.speaker: brenda
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!
beats.visual: Western face-off: Brenda CU ('huss' face, body still) vs the lamppost, tighter each time; crowd leans in.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: The lamppost flickered. It's out!
beats.visual: The bulb flickers; OUT stamp on the lamppost; confetti, crowd cheers, trophy in Brenda's hand.

beats.speaker: marcus
beats.text: Brenda, how did you win?
beats.visual: Marcus walks up, stunned, shrug.

beats.speaker: brenda
beats.text: While you were out partying, by the way.
beats.visual: CU Brenda: only her mouth moves; sunglasses glint.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Number one: I said that in my sleep.
beats.visual: TOP 10 #1; Marcus lifts her sunglasses: eyes shut, Zzz.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Stand still long enough and you become a hotel. A pigeon.

card.quote: Stand still long enough and you become a hotel.

beats.visual: QUOTE CARD; reveal: the pigeon flaps down and settles into Brenda's bun.

beats.speaker: brenda
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!
beats.visual: Button: asleep standing up, trophy in hand; each snored HUSS pops a snore bubble, the pigeon puffs with it.
